meta.name: Nook design system
meta.status: Agreed visual direction with explicit implementation defaults
meta.description: A calm, spacious social and gaming platform: pure black, neutral gray surfaces, white text, restrained orange accents, Inter, Tabler Icons, and square corners.
meta.format: Plain JSON. Numeric dimensions are CSS pixels unless the key states another unit. Component token names reference keys in colors.
notes: The latest square-corner decision overrides the older 6px radius guidance.
Circular avatars and small status dots are deliberate exceptions.
Exact default sizes below select concrete values within the agreed design ranges; they are not pixel measurements from generated images.
Mobile layout design is deferred. Preserve semantic structure and avoid choices that prevent later adaptation.
This document specifies presentation, not which backend features are implemented.

principles.canvas: Always pure black for the default theme.
principles.density: Generous negative space; no widgets added solely to fill empty areas.
principles.borders: Use sparingly. Use a visible control border where an outline is needed to identify an input.
principles.imagery: Natural, muted photography. Let user imagery provide personality without forcing an orange filter.

typography.fontLoading: Load Inter once at application level; retain system fallbacks.
typography.copy: Sentence case; concise labels; no all-caps paragraphs.

shape.overlayShadow: Optional and restrained, only when separation requires it.

navigation.activeStyle: Subtle charcoal surface with an orange icon or a small orange marker.

futureResponsiveGuidance.status: Guidance only; mobile screen design comes later.
futureResponsiveGuidance.chat: Use separate list and thread views on small screens.
futureResponsiveGuidance.auth: Hide the optional editorial photo panel on small screens.

icons.brandIcons: Use official GitHub and Discord SVG assets; default to monochrome.
icons.accessibility: Icon-only controls need accessible names and generous hit areas.

rules: One primary action per local task.
Keep disabled and loading states distinct.
Preserve the label while an action is loading.

input.label: Persistent visible label; placeholder is not a label.

dialog.closeControl: Visible close action with an accessible name.
behavior: Return focus to the trigger when closed.

tabs.style: Small underline or marker; no outline around every tab.

avatar.fallback: Readable initials or a consistent default avatar.

card.border: Optional subtle separator; not the default grouping mechanism.

toast.behavior: Quiet confirmation; errors remain close to the relevant field or action.

tooltip.rule: Never hide essential instructions exclusively in a tooltip.

post.spacing: Use generous separation; no mandatory card around each post.

message.grouping: Group by author and time; avoid boxing every message.

notificationItem.rule: Pair unread state with readable context, not color alone.

motion.loading: Use layout-preserving skeletons or a quiet progress indicator when useful.

accessibility.target: WCAG AA contrast; verify actual foreground/background pairs.
requirements: Text or icon alongside status colors

pagePatterns.landing: Slim header, spacious hero, one primary CTA, restrained product preview, short feature sections, quiet footer.
pagePatterns.auth: No app sidebar. Narrow form with optional muted editorial photo. Login, signup, and recovery share structure.
pagePatterns.home: Feed is the default signed-in surface inside the shared application shell.
pagePatterns.feed: Readable central column, quiet composer, generous post spacing, useful optional right rail.
pagePatterns.search: Prominent filled search field, restrained tabs, spacious user/content results, clear actions.
pagePatterns.chat: Conversation/channel list, main thread, optional details panel, anchored composer.
pagePatterns.play: Make the active game the focal point; keep controls and match details secondary.
pagePatterns.profile: Restrained banner, circular avatar, clear identity and bio, relevant actions, small content tab set.
pagePatterns.settings: Secondary settings navigation, readable form column, clear save feedback; private data stays in owner views.
pagePatterns.notifications: Compact bell popover for recent items, clear unread state and destinations; use a full inbox when needed.

shadcn.purpose: Semantic dark-theme mapping, with square corners applied to every rectangular component.
shadcn.valueFormat: CSS color strings. Convert explicitly if an integration expects HSL channels.
shadcn.note: The shadcn accent role is a neutral interactive surface here. Primary carries Nook orange.

contentAndScope.mockupContent: Names, posts, counts, game artwork, and optional controls in generated mockups are placeholders.
contentAndScope.featureClaims: A design does not establish that an endpoint or feature exists.
contentAndScope.profileThemes: Nitro-like customization is a separate later feature; it does not change the default shell palette.
